title: kb-dispatch-recovery.v1
description: Structural JSON Schema for the kb-dispatch-recovery.v1 terminal block (WK-0125, DEC-0037). Passed to `claude --json-schema` / `codex --output-schema` for implement-mode constrained decoding ONLY (pipeline.ts) — advisory modes (code_review/redteam) never receive this schema; the block stays opportunistic prose there (DEC-0037). Reshaped to the OpenAI/Anthropic strict structured-output subset: every property is required and optional fields are nullable (null == absent), no unsupported validation keywords (const/minLength/maxLength/minimum/pattern/format), no oneOf/allOf/anyOf combinator anywhere. Cross-field semantics this structural schema cannot express (which reported_outcome values are valid for which reported_role, finding_counts consistency with findings, outcome/findings consistency, kind being worker-only) remain enforced by recovery-block.ts's validateRecoveryPayload, which re-validates every block regardless of whether it was constrained-decoded — this schema only makes wrong FIELD NAMES/TYPES structurally impossible, the failure mode WK-0125 observed 4/4 times across 3/3 model families. Derived from and must be kept in sync with packages/dispatch-core/src/recovery-block.ts (TOP_LEVEL_REQUIRED_FIELDS/TOP_LEVEL_OPTIONAL_FIELDS/FINDING_REQUIRED_FIELDS/FINDING_OPTIONAL_FIELDS/AFFECTED_PATH_FIELDS/FINDING_COUNT_FIELDS/REVIEWED_CONTROL_FIELDS and the closed vocabularies). kb-owned schema (DEC-0009 carve-out: kb authors the kb-dispatch-recovery.v1 format, so this is not an external-shape assumption). Design mirrors agent-chassis's agent-role-result.v1.schema.json (ELv2: shape mirrored, authored fresh) with one kb-specific addition: the `kind` field (recovery-block.ts divergence 2 in its module doc).

reported_subject.description: The handoff id this block reports on (e.g. HO-0042).

reported_outcome.description: Worker outcomes (completed|partial|blocked|failed) or reviewer/redteam findings outcomes (no_findings|passed_no_blocking_or_medium_findings|changes_requested) — the full union; which subset is valid for which reported_role is a cross-field rule recovery-block.ts's validateRecoveryPayload enforces (role_outcome_mismatch), not this structural schema.

summary.description: One-paragraph free-text summary. Optional in recovery-block.ts; null when omitted.

kind.description: kb extension (recovery-block.ts divergence 2): worker-only diagnostic routing hint. Always null for reviewer/redteam payloads (recovery-block.ts's kind_not_allowed_for_role check).

path.description: Repo-relative path — no leading slash, no drive letter, no '.'/'..' segments (recovery-block.ts's isRepoRelativePath).

finding_counts.description: Must match the recomputed aggregate of findings[] (recovery-block.ts's validateFindingCountConsistency) — a cross-field rule this structural schema cannot express.

control_id.description: Non-null (unlike finding.control_id) and unique within reviewed_controls[] (recovery-block.ts's duplicate_reviewed_control check).
